description: Ports that must own an eight-queue VOQ bundle for the commissioned datapath. This is INTENT, checked against an allocation capture by ffn_queue_provision.py -- it does not allocate anything itself.
derived_from: COPPER-FORWARDING.md -- port 15, added 2026-09-16, NOT yet in any capture here
notes: Every entry below was observed with queues=8; none of these counts is a design choice made here.
Roles come from FORWARDING-FABRIC.md and COPPER-FORWARDING.md. Where a capture records a port but no document names its purpose, the role says so rather than guessing.
Allocation handles (connector/VOQ gports) are deliberately NOT in this file. They are observations that change across a switch restart, and pinning them would invite reuse of a stale identifier.
